pages.text: Follow moves after the owner; Wait pauses ordinary work. New workers wait, including Creative defaults and specialization of a recovered Friendly Slime. Stored companions retain their saved order.

Mining uses Mine, carriers Haul, heralds Watch, combat and dragons Fight, cleaners Clean, farmers Farm, and lumberjacks Chop. Healers use Search, warehouses Store, fishers Fish, abundance Nurture, and tunnelers Tunnel. Soggy and Meow Slimes can Roam; Meow activation is independent.
Only the owner may manage or recover a companion. Giving a recovered item to someone else does not change ownership. Workers, healers, and carriers normally cooperate with the same owner’s team.
